result: The live session flow composes the 225 host and isolation gate over the 260 shell. Academy and Chaos have distinct identities, profiles, checkpoints and ledgers. Switching closes the world, commits one checkpoint, invalidates old jobs and launches PAUSED_AUTO. Reset commits SCENARIO_RESET before advancing worldEpoch/learningEpoch and preserves style, XP, daily, rewards and KPI. Failed saves preserve the world and epochs. Late results are refused by 225 identity. The shell adopts the session context only at a tick boundary.
limitations: The live checkpoint store is the 225 deterministic in-memory store; durable IndexedDB remains 278. Full physical scene rehydration is not claimed: restore adopts the checkpoint and launches PAUSED_AUTO, while the V3 scene is reset to spawn. Live segments and jobs do not exist yet (271/272); the port reports zero production closes/invalidations and the contract is proven with deterministic doubles. Traffic and destructible decor remain 262/285. The parent cannot rerun npm run session:probe because Playwright is not installed; the committed browser evidence is MEASURED WebGL2+WebGPU from the implementation worktree.
